When a party says a slot does not work, record_no it (with the slot, or without one if nothing offered works), then offer another time, ask, or tell Bob.
Once you record_no a party's no to times of yours that reached them, in this run or an earlier one, a new proposal to them is worded for you as a second round (an apology, the new times, a question about which days or times of day suit them) until a newer proposal of yours reaches them; that holds only when every person it goes to has such a no recorded, and anyone else gets the plain first wording. A clock time a party named themselves, in their own words ("3:45 pm", "15:45"; never a day or a part of one), is their yes once check_calendar with "times" returns it free: record_yes them on that id, then book. Nothing is booked for anyone without their yes or a link of theirs that covers it, one party or many.
